abstract: Three cases of testicular malignancies arising in undescended testes were treated in the Department of Surgery, Singapore General Hospital. The patients were all adult Chinese male who presented with tumours arising in unilateral, intra-abdominal undescended testes. Two of the tumours were seminomas while the third was a choriocarcinoma. In all 3 cases, the tumours were large and at an advanced stage at the time of presentation. The treatment in these cases was surgical excision of the primary lesion followed by radiotherapy or chemotherapy. The patient with choriocarcinoma died soon after chemotherapy was initiated while the other two cases are alive, one for over 6 years with no recurrence.
abstract_ja: 本報告は、シンガポール総合病院で治療した、片側性の腹腔内停留精巣に生じた悪性腫瘍の3例を記述する。3例はいずれも成人男性であった。腫瘍は大きく、受診時に進行した病期であった。治療は原発巣の外科的切除の後、放射線療法または化学療法を行った。絨毛癌の患者は化学療法開始直後に死亡し、他の2例（セミノーマ）は生存している。うち1例は6年以上にわたり再発を認めていない。
